manifest.author: RapterBox
manifest.description: Emit this box's census as deterministic static JSON — protocol revision, anchor hash, resident populations, posture, trust — computed from local filesystem and git facts with NO language-model call. Byte-stable for the same inputs, sorted and string-valued so it drops straight into a rapp/1 frame payload and two boxes computing the same census produce the same hash. Counts things, never names them.
manifest.name: @rapter/hive_census_agent

write.description: Also write the census to the local static path so peers can read it without a model call.
